2.name: Cannot connect to Wi-Fi network
2.transcript: Cannot connect to the Wi-Fi network. Please check the Wi-Fi password and try again later.

3.name: Cannot connect to server
3.transcript: Cannot connect to the server. Please check your local network and try again later.

4.name: Robot exited network configuration mode
4.transcript: The vacuum has exited network configuration mode.

6.name: Network connection failed
6.transcript: Network connection failed. Please try again later.

13.name: Returning to base to charge
13.transcript: Returning to the dock to charge.

14.name: Low battery: charge and resume
14.transcript: Low battery, returning to the dock to charge. The vacuum will resume once charged.

17.name: Please move the robot to the base to charge
17.transcript: Please take the vacuum to the charging base to charge.

19.name: Please remove the robot from the base before switching off
19.transcript: Please remove the vacuum from the dock before switching it off.

21.name: Low battery: robot will switch off
21.transcript: Low battery, the vacuum will switch off.

25.name: Low battery: cannot run scheduled task
25.transcript: Low battery, scheduled cleaning cannot be carried out.

27.name: Updating
27.transcript: Updating. This takes about 5 minutes. Do not switch off or start a cleaning task.

29.name: Update failed, please try again
29.transcript: Update failed. Please try again later.

31.name: Positioning failed
31.transcript: Positioning failed. The map is invalid. The vacuum will start a new clean.

34.name: Dust bin not fitted
34.transcript: Dust bin not fitted. Please fit it.

35.name: Main brush error
35.transcript: Main brush error. Please check and clean it.

36.name: Side brush error
36.transcript: Side brush error. Please check and clean it.

37.name: Right wheel error
37.transcript: Right wheel error. Please check and clean it.

38.name: Left wheel error
38.transcript: Left wheel error. Please check and clean it.

39.name: Please clean the cliff sensor
39.transcript: The wheels are not touching the floor. Please wipe the cliff sensors, reposition the robot and restart it.

40.name: Robot is stuck
40.transcript: The robot is stuck. Please remove the obstacles around it.

41.name: Robot wheels suspended
41.transcript: The wheels are not touching the floor. Please reposition the robot and restart it.

42.name: Please check and clean the filter
42.transcript: Please check and clean the filter.

43.name: Bumper error
43.transcript: Bumper error. Please tap it gently to check whether it springs back.

44.name: Error
44.transcript: Error. Please check the user manual or contact customer services.

46.name: Robot and phone connected
46.transcript: The vacuum and phone are connected. Please return to the app to wait for the result.

48.name: Low battery: returning to base
48.transcript: Low battery, returning to the charging base.

50.name: Charging error
50.transcript: Charging error. Please clean the charging contacts.

52.name: Robot tilted
52.transcript: The vacuum is tilted. Please place it on a level floor to restart.

55.name: Position found: returning to base
55.transcript: Positioning successful. Continuing to return to the dock.

59.name: Mopping complete
59.transcript: Mopping complete. Please remove the water tank promptly.

64.name: Invalid map: returning to base
64.transcript: Positioning failed. The map is invalid. The vacuum will return to the charging base.

65.name: Continue returning to dock
65.transcript: Continuing to return to the dock.

66.name: Filter worn
66.transcript: The filter is worn. Please replace it promptly.

67.name: Side brush worn
67.transcript: The side brush is worn. Please replace it promptly.

68.name: Main brush worn
68.transcript: The main brush is worn. Please replace it promptly.

71.name: Laser sensor error
71.transcript: Please check whether the laser distance sensor is jammed.

72.name: LDS cover jammed
72.transcript: Please check whether the laser distance sensor cover is jammed.

73.name: Edge sensor error
73.transcript: Edge sensor error. Please check and clean it.

75.name: Filter may be damp or clogged
75.transcript: The filter may be damp or clogged.

77.name: Please start the robot in an area without carpet
77.transcript: Please start the vacuum in an area without carpet.

81.name: Ultrasonic sensor error
81.transcript: Carpet sensor error. Please restart the robot or contact customer services.

87.name: Low battery: returning to base
87.transcript: Low battery, returning to the charging base.

91.name: Clean water tank not fitted
91.transcript: Clean water tank not fitted. Please fit it.

93.name: Not enough water in clean water tank
93.transcript: The water level in the clean water tank is low. Please add water.

102.name: Dust bag full or air duct blocked
102.transcript: The dust bag is full or the air duct is blocked. Please replace the bag or clean the air duct promptly.

108.name: Washboard water level abnormal
108.transcript: There is a fault with the clean water level. Please clean it promptly.

109.name: Dirty water tank fault
109.transcript: Dirty water tank fault. Please make sure it is fitted and empty.

111.name: Mop pads removed
111.transcript: Mop pads removed. Please fit them before continuing.

112.name: Place robot in the washing base
112.transcript: Place the vacuum back on the self-wash base before use.

113.name: Task complete
113.transcript: Task complete. Please empty the dirty water tank promptly.

118.name: Buttons locked
118.transcript: Buttons locked. Press and hold the dock button to unlock.

139.name: Continue returning to base for self-cleaning

140.name: New environment detected
140.transcript: New environment detected, returning to the self-wash base.

142.name: Mop pad worn
142.transcript: The mop pad is worn. Please replace it promptly.

148.name: Return to base for self-cleaning
148.transcript: Return to the base for self-cleaning.

149.name: Cannot reach target: obstacle in path
149.transcript: Cannot reach the specified area. Please try clearing obstacles from the path.

150.name: Cannot reach target: no-go zone
150.transcript: Cannot reach the specified area. Please try removing the no-go zones on the path.

151.name: Path blocked: physical obstacle nearby
151.transcript: Path blocked. Please try clearing obstacles around your vacuum.

152.name: Path blocked: no-go zone
152.transcript: Path blocked. Please try removing the no-go zones or move your vacuum out of this area.

153.name: Robot detected in a no-go zone
153.transcript: Your vacuum has been detected in a no-go zone. Please move it out of this area.

166.name: Please remove foreign objects tangled in the mop pad
166.transcript: Please remove any foreign objects tangled in the mop pad.

173.name: Please replace the silver ion steriliser
173.transcript: Please replace the silver ion steriliser.

179.name: Mop cleaned
179.transcript: Mop cleaned. There is not enough water in the clean water tank. Please fill the clean water tank and empty the dirty water tank.

181.name: Insufficient water
181.transcript: Insufficient water. Please fill the clean water tank.

186.name: Please check the clean water tank
186.transcript: Please check the clean water tank.

187.name: This will take about 5 to 10 minutes
187.transcript: This will take about 5 to 10 minutes.

255.name: Smart obstacle avoidance required
255.transcript: Sorry, this task can only be carried out when smart obstacle avoidance is enabled.

259.name: Heading to target location
259.transcript: Self-positioned. Heading to the specified location.

261.name: Continuing to target location
261.transcript: Self-positioned, continuing to the specified location.

269.name: Please try again once the current task is complete
269.transcript: Please try again once the current task is complete.

281.name: Robot is auto-emptying
281.transcript: The robot vacuum is auto-emptying. Please try again later.

282.name: Robot is cleaning the mop pad
282.transcript: The robot vacuum is cleaning the mop pad. Please try again later.

283.name: Robot is not on the base
283.transcript: The robot vacuum is not on the base station. Please try again later.

296.name: Dirty water tank fault
296.transcript: Dirty water tank fault. Please check whether the dirty water tank is full.

297.name: Detergent bottle fitted: reset counter
297.transcript: Detergent bottle fitted. If the detergent has not been used, please reset it in the app.

299.name: Detergent auto-dosing module fitted
299.transcript: Detergent bottle and auto-dosing module fitted.

315.name: Mop pad not in base
315.transcript: The mop pad is not in the base station. Please place it in the base station and try again, or fit it manually.

316.name: Mop pad already in base
316.transcript: The mop pad is already in the base station.

319.name: Mop pads could not be removed
319.transcript: The mop pads could not be removed. Please remove them manually.

320.name: Mop pads could not be fitted
320.transcript: The mop pads could not be fitted. Please fit them manually.

329.name: Self-test started
329.transcript: Starting self-test, please do not move me away from the base station.

330.name: Self-test in progress
330.transcript: Please try again once the self-test is complete.

331.name: Self-test: no faults
331.transcript: No faults found, you can use this device safely.

332.name: Self-test: fault found
332.transcript: A fault was found, please go to the app to view the details.

341.name: Found you
341.transcript: Found you, starting to follow now. You can say "stop following" to end following.

342.name: Where are you
342.transcript: Where are you? Please stand about 1.5 metres in front of me.

343.name: I've lost you
343.transcript: I've lost you, you're walking too fast. Please stand about 1.5 metres in front of me and wait for me to find you again.

349.name: Make sure the base is switched on
349.transcript: Make sure the base station is switched on. Place the robot on it to start activation.

352.name: Base station activation failed
352.transcript: Base station activation failed. Open the app to view the solution.

355.name: Water level low, please fill the clean water tank
355.transcript: Low water level, please fill the clean water tank.

356.name: Fault still present
356.transcript: The fault is still present, the scheduled task has been cancelled.

360.name: Robot is draining its water tank

362.name: Mop not in place: vacuuming only
362.transcript: The mop pad has come off; the robot will carry out a vacuuming task instead.

363.name: Vacuuming complete, robot will start mopping
363.transcript: Vacuuming task complete. The robot will start mopping.

364.name: Start setting the video activation code
364.transcript: Start setting the video activation code

373.name: Clean water outflow finished
373.transcript: The clean water flow has finished. Please wait 10 seconds, then clean the base station once the dirt has soaked.

374.name: Clean the base tray
374.transcript: Please use a brush or cloth to clean the bottom of the base station within 20 seconds. The waste will then be pumped out automatically.

375.name: Please push the dirt towards the pump inlet
375.transcript: Please push the dirt towards the pump inlet; pumping takes 30 seconds.

376.name: Pumping complete
376.transcript: Pumping finished. Please clean the washboard separately and refit it.

377.name: Network cannot be configured
377.transcript: Network cannot be configured. Please contact customer services.

378.name: Wrong Wi-Fi password
378.transcript: Wrong password, cannot connect to the network. Please reconfigure.

379.name: Wireless network not found, please connect to 2.4 GHz
379.transcript: Wireless network not found. Please connect to the 2.4 GHz wireless band. Place the robot near the router and try again.

380.name: Could not obtain an IP address
380.transcript: Could not obtain an IP address, please check the router settings.

381.name: Could not connect to EMQ server
381.transcript: Cannot connect to the EMQ server. Please contact customer services.

382.name: Could not connect to network
382.transcript: Cannot connect to the network. Please check whether the network is working normally.

383.name: Network cannot be configured
383.transcript: Network cannot be configured. Please contact customer services.

384.name: No clean water in automatic water system
384.transcript: There is no water in the clean water tank or drainage unit of the automatic water supply.

388.name: Robot in a restricted area
388.transcript: Restricted area, please move the robot to a suitable area and try again.

389.name: LDS failed to lower
389.transcript: Cannot lower the LDS. Please check whether it is stuck.

390.name: LDS could not be raised
390.transcript: Cannot raise the LDS. Please check whether it is stuck.

391.name: Place in an open area for the task
391.transcript: Please move me to an open area before starting the task.

396.name: Draining water module
396.transcript: Starting to drain the water supply and drainage module, expected to take 3 minutes.

397.name: Upper and lower water draining complete
397.transcript: Upper and lower water draining complete.

398.name: Mapping complete: take to base
398.transcript: Mapping complete. Check the map in the app and take me to the docking point.

399.name: Test complete, please take me back to the base
399.transcript: Task complete. Please take me back to the docking point.

401.name: Base for self-cleaning
401.transcript: Please take me to the docking point and start the self-cleaning task.

424.name: Positioning failed
424.transcript: Positioning failed, please move me to an open area and restart the task.

426.name: I slipped and got stuck
426.transcript: I slipped and got stuck; I'll keep trying to free myself.

434.name: Extra cleaning complete
434.transcript: Extra cleaning complete, resuming the original clean.

437.name: Problem solved: resume cleaning
437.transcript: Problem solved, tap the start button to resume cleaning.

438.name: Bumper jammed
438.transcript: The bumper is jammed. Please tap it gently so it springs back normally.

439.name: LDS cover jammed
439.transcript: The LDS cover is jammed. Please tap its flexible area gently so it springs back normally.

440.name: Wheels off the ground
440.transcript: The robot vacuum's wheels are suspended. Please move it to an open area and restart the task.

441.name: Main brush tangled
441.transcript: Something is tangled in the main brush. Please remove and clean it before refitting.

442.name: Side brush tangled
442.transcript: Something is tangled in the side brush. Please remove and clean it before refitting.

443.name: Main wheels tangled, please clean
443.transcript: Something is tangled in the main wheels, please clean them.

444.name: Place robot in an open area
444.transcript: Please move the robot to an open area before starting the task.

445.name: Mop fell off
445.transcript: The mop has fallen off. Please check around the robot, find the mop and refit it.

446.name: Mop holder tangled, please remove and clean
446.transcript: Something is tangled in the mop holder, please remove and clean it.

447.name: Base power off
447.transcript: The base station is not switched on. Please check it and put the robot back on to charge.

448.name: Dirty water tank not fitted
448.transcript: The dirty water tank is not fitted. Please put it in place before starting the task.

449.name: Cannot start a task on carpet
449.transcript: Cannot start a task on carpet. Please move the robot to a hard floor and restart the task.

450.name: Cannot start a task in a no-go zone
450.transcript: Cannot start a task in a no-go zone. Please move the robot to another area and restart the task.

451.name: Cannot start a task in a restricted area
451.transcript: Cannot start tasks in a restricted area. Please move the robot to another area and restart the task.

452.name: Carpet sensor error
452.transcript: Carpet sensor error. Please turn the robot over, wipe the white round hole underneath and restart the robot.

453.name: Edge sensor error
453.transcript: Edge sensor error. Please wipe the right side of the robot and restart the task.

454.name: Not enough clean water
454.transcript: There is not enough water in the clean water tank. Please fill it with clean water promptly.

455.name: Clean water tank not in place
455.transcript: The clean water tank is not in place. Please fit it.

456.name: Dirty water tank full / not fitted
456.transcript: The dirty water tank is full or not fitted, please check it.

457.name: Dirty water tank full / not fitted
457.transcript: The dirty water tank is full or not fitted, please check it.

458.name: Dust bag not in place, please check and fit it
458.transcript: The dust bag is not in place, please check and fit it.

459.name: Mop holder in wrong position
459.transcript: The mop holder is not in place, please check and fit it.

460.name: Deodoriser worn out
460.transcript: The dirty water tank deodoriser is worn out, please replace it promptly.

463.name: Welcome to your Dreame robot
463.transcript: Welcome to your Dreame robot vacuum. To see more features, please open the robot vacuum's lid, scan the QR code and download the Dreamehome app.

464.name: Place on base before task
464.transcript: To complete subsequent tasks smoothly, place the robot back on the base before starting tasks. Setup is complete when you hear the "start charging" prompt.

465.name: Place on base before task
465.transcript: Place the robot back on the base before starting tasks. Setup is complete when you hear the "start charging" prompt.

466.name: Prepare rooms before cleaning
466.transcript: Please open the doors of the rooms to be cleaned and pick up items from the floor.

467.name: Place on base before mapping
467.transcript: Please place the robot back on the base, then start mapping again.

468.name: Please confirm the map details in the app
468.transcript: Please confirm the map details in the app.

478.name: Resume after mop washing
478.transcript: Once mop washing is complete, the robot will resume the cleaning task where it left off.

480.name: Add water for the next task
480.transcript: Put enough water in the clean water tank for the next tasks.

517.name: Pet found
517.transcript: Successfully found your pet, starting to return to charge.

518.name: Pet not found, returning to charge
518.transcript: Pet not found, starting to return to charge.

632.name: Changing language
632.transcript: Changing language, this will take about 30 seconds.

636.name: Auto-wash dirty mop
636.transcript: The mop is dirty; please take the robot to the docking point for automatic mop washing.

658.name: Descaler expired
658.transcript: The descaler has expired, please replace it promptly.

661.name: Washboard cleaning
661.transcript: Start cleaning the washboard base; this will take about 45 to 60 seconds.

662.name: Start producing electrolysed water to clean them
662.transcript: Start preparing electrolysed water to clean the mop.

663.name: Abnormal water level detected in washboard
663.transcript: Abnormal water level detected in the washboard. Please clean the washboard filter and filter channel, then restart the task.

673.name: Extendable legs tangled
673.transcript: Something may be tangled in the extendable legs. Please clean the legs before starting tasks.

677.name: Cannot reach target: threshold / zone
677.transcript: Cannot reach the specified area. Please remove no-go zones or impassable thresholds on the path.

678.name: Path blocked: threshold / zone
678.transcript: Cleaning path blocked. Please remove no-go zones or impassable thresholds on the map, or move the robot out of the area.

679.name: Robot in a threshold / no-go zone
679.transcript: The robot vacuum is blocked in a no-go zone or an impassable threshold area. Please move it out of the area.
